scores.visual_critic_note: Intentional Paul Tol palette, clean search bar with inline icon, and descendant count badges create a polished, functional tree—but the bottom half of the viewport is empty wasted space and the legend sits inside the SVG where it can conflict with tree content at larger expansions.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Purely structural/topological tree with no quantitative encodings to misrepresent — color encodes categorical rank correctly, node size encodes internal/leaf type not data magnitude, descendant counts shown as text labels not scaled area, and SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent; minor robustness weakness in key function (name+depth concatenation without unique IDs) is non-critical for this dataset.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before new transitions on node/link selections means rapid clicks or searches during a 500ms transition can cause positional jumps; all other checks pass (search is debounced 200ms, pointer events API prevents mouse-touch fights, no cross-view dispatch loops, no stale scale closures).
scores.cognitive_load_note: Progressive disclosure (2-level default collapse, +N counts, search-to-expand) expertly manages a ~200-node tree into a clean 15-node default view with 6 well-differentiated rank colors; full-expand state with long taxonomic names could crowd at leaf level but is user-initiated and scrollable.
